2. Set up the word app (10 min): open [Слово за словом](https://anki-russian.onrender.com/) on your phone and add it to your home screen. Under Options, enter the same email as on this page so your words sync between phone and laptop.
3. Record your ‘before’ sample (5 min): a 2-minute answer to «Расскажи о себе и о своей жизни в Ташкенте», even if it's mostly English or silence. Keep the file. [AI voice chat](https://chatgpt.com/)
4. Why and when (5 min): write in the notes below why you want Russian, and your B2 date (today plus 300 days). [What B2 means](https://pushkininstitute.ru/certified2)

5. Words (15 min): open the word app, [Слово за словом](https://anki-russian.onrender.com/), and press Start. Each new word comes with its meaning and an example: say it out loud, press Got it, and a minute later the app checks you.

6. Learn (20 min): Alphabet, reading and typing. Study it from [Russian for Free: how to read Russian](https://www.russianforfree.com/lessons-how-to-read-in-russian-01.php) · [Master Russian: the alphabet with sounds](https://masterrussian.com/blalphabet.shtml).
